answer.summary: For a one-sided pooled-variance t-test comparing two independent groups with equal sample sizes (32 per group), an expected mean difference of 4.3 dBA, and common standard deviation of 7.8 dBA, the statistical power at significance level α = 0.05 is 0.704 (approximately 70.4%).
answer.method: Two-sample t-test using non-central t-distribution. Effect size Cohen's d = 4.3 / 7.8 = 0.5513. Non-centrality parameter λ = d × √(n/2) = 0.5513 × √16 = 2.2051. Degrees of freedom = 2n − 2 = 62. Critical t-value for one-sided test at α = 0.05 is t₀.₉₅,₆₂ = 1.6698. Power = P(t₆₂ > 1.6698 | λ = 2.2051) evaluated via the cumulative distribution function of the non-central t-distribution.

# Two-sample t-test power calculation
# Design: Two independent normal groups with equal variances
# Parameters:
#   - Expected difference in means (effect): 4.3 dBA
#   - Common standard deviation: 7.8 dBA
#   - Sample size per group: 32
#   - Significance level: 0.05
#   - Test type: One-sided, pooled variance t-test

library(stats)

# Input parameters
effect_size_diff <- 4.3  # dBA
common_sd <- 7.8          # dBA
n_per_group <- 32
alpha <- 0.05
sidedness <- 1            # one-sided

# Calculate Cohen's d effect size
cohens_d <- effect_size_diff / common_sd

# Degrees of freedom for two-sample t-test
df <- 2 * n_per_group - 2

# Non-centrality parameter
# For two equal-sample-size groups: lambda = cohens_d * sqrt(n/2)
lambda <- cohens_d * sqrt(n_per_group / 2)

# Critical value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05
# For one-sided test: qt(1 - alpha, df)
t_critical <- qt(1 - alpha, df)

# Power = P(t > t_critical | non-centrality = lambda) under alternative
# This uses the non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(t_critical, df, ncp = lambda)

# Display results
cat("Two-Sample t-Test Power Calculation\n")
cat("====================================\n")
cat("Design parameters:\n")
cat("  Expected difference in means:", effect_size_diff, "dBA\n")
cat("  Common standard deviation:", common_sd, "dBA\n")
cat("  Sample size per group:", n_per_group, "participants\n")
cat("  Total participants:", 2 * n_per_group, "\n")
cat("  Significance level (alpha):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Test type: One-sided, pooled variance t-test\n")
cat("\nCalculated values:\n")
cat("  Cohen's d effect size:", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n")
cat("  Degrees of freedom:", df, "\n")
cat("  Non-centrality parameter (lambda):", round(lambda, 4), "\n")
cat("  Critical t-value:", round(t_critical, 4), "\n")
cat("\nResult:\n")
cat("  Power:", round(power, 4), "\n")

# Output JSON for structured reporting
results <- data.frame(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = results), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
